name: GetTableRangeFromExcelWorksheetNode
label: Get Table Range from Excel Worksheet
description: Gets the range address, row count, and column count of an Excel Table (ListObject) in the specified worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet containing the table.

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: The name of the table (ListObject) to retrieve. If empty, uses the first table found.

fields.name: TableRangeAddress
fields.label: Table Range Address
fields.description: The address of the table range.

fields.name: RowCount
fields.label: Row Count
fields.description: The number of data rows in the table.

fields.name: ColumnCount
fields.label: Column Count
fields.description: The number of columns in the table.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the table data (excluding header).

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the table.
